title: Auction Theory and Device Bidding Functions for Transactive Energy Systems: A Review
excerpt: Comprehensive review of auction theory and device bidding functions for transactive energy systems. Equal contribution with A. Sreekumar.
citation: Sreekumar, A.*, Sakthivelu, A.*, and Kiesling, L. (2023). "Auction Theory and Device Bidding Functions for Transactive Energy Systems: A Review." Current Sustainable/Renewable Energy Reports. 10(3): 102-111.

title: A Real-Time Limit Order Book as a Market Mechanism for Transactive Energy Systems
venue: IEEE Power & Energy Society General Meeting (PESGM)
excerpt: Published a novel LOB market mechanism for price discovery and order-matching for real-time retail electricity markets. Selected as one of the best conference papers.
citation: Sreekumar, A., Sakthivelu, A., Baltaduonis, R., Kiesling, L., Hoedl, S., and Chassin, D. P. (2023). "A Real-Time Limit Order Book as a Market Mechanism for Transactive Energy Systems." 2023 IEEE Power & Energy Society General Meeting (PESGM). 1-5.

title: An Energy-Efficient Ride-Sharing Algorithm Using Distributed Convex Optimization
excerpt: Developed a ride-sharing optimization with focus on energy-efficiency and decentralized decision-making (ADMM) agents for rider pickup and drop-off, as part of localized clusters of connected cars.
citation: Jayakrishnan, S., Sakthivelu, A. (2022). "An Energy-Efficient Ride-Sharing Algorithm Using Distributed Convex Optimization." Stanford University Course Project.

title: US incentive based demand response program parameters
